transactions.desc: The Tigers optioned Hanifee to Triple-A Toledo on Friday.
The Tigers reinstated Jobe (elbow) from the injured list Friday.
The Blue Jays optioned Lee to Triple-A Buffalo on Friday.
The Giants selected Harris' contract from Triple-A Sacramento on Friday.
The Giants optioned Beck to Triple-A Sacramento on Friday.
The Rays recalled Williams from Triple-A Durham on Friday.
The Astros recalled Meyers from Triple-A Sugar Land on Friday, Chandler Rome of The Athletic reports.
The Diamondbacks recalled Strowd from Triple-A Reno on Friday.
The Diamondbacks optioned Drake to Triple-A Reno on Friday.
The Mariners recalled Davila from Triple-A Tacoma on Friday.
The Twins selected Culpepper's contract from Triple-A St. Paul on Friday.
The Twins designated Rashi for assignment Friday.
The Twins optioned Gray to Triple-A St. Paul on Friday.
The Guardians recalled Aleman from Triple-A Columbus on Friday.
The Rangers designated Kingham for assignment Friday.
The Rangers activated Montgomery (elbow) from the 60-day injured list Friday.
The Royals optioned Bummer to Triple-A Omaha on Friday, and Bummer elected to become a free agent.
The Royals recalled Black from Triple-A Omaha on Friday.
The Red Sox selected Burgos' contract from Triple-A Worcester on Friday.
The Red Sox optioned Weissert to Triple-A Worcester on Friday, Tim Healey of The Boston Globe reports.
The White Sox recalled Sandlin from Triple-A Charlotte on Friday.
The White Sox recalled Quero from Triple-A Charlotte on Friday.
The Angels recalled Klassen from Triple-A Salt Lake on Friday.
The Nationals released Littell on Friday.
Knizner exercised his opt-out clause with the Red Sox on Friday and is now a free agent, Jon Heyman of the New York Post reports.
The Blue Jays designated Martin for assignment Friday.
The Blue Jays selected Bateman's contract from Triple-A Buffalo on Friday.
The Mets claimed Arias off waivers from the Guardians on Friday, Tim Stebbins of MLB.com reports.
The White Sox released Hays on Friday, Scott Merkin of MLB.com reports.
The Angels claimed Watson off waivers from the Red Sox on Friday.
